input.prompt:
## Objective
Research and report: What is the current LTS (Long Term Support) version of Node.js in August 2026, and when was it released?

## Context
The current date is August 5, 2026. Find official Node.js release information from nodejs.org or its GitHub repository. Identify:
1. The active LTS version number (e.g., 22.x, 24.x, etc.)
2. The exact release date when this version entered LTS
3. The LTS codename (if applicable)
4. The end-of-life date for this LTS version

## Output Contract
Return your findings in this exact format:

### NODE.JS LTS VERSION (AUGUST 2026)
- **Version**: [version number]
- **LTS Start Date**: [date]
- **Codename**: [codename]
- **EOL Date**: [date]
- **Latest Patch**: [latest patch version]

### SOURCES
- [URL 1] - [brief description of what was found]
- [URL 2] - [brief description]

All factual claims must carry a VERIFIED or VERIFIED (cross-source) confidence marker. Cross-reference at least 2 independent sources.

## Boundaries
- Only official Node.js release sources (nodejs.org, GitHub nodejs/Release, GitHub nodejs/node)
- Do not use AI-generated summaries, blog posts, or third-party articles as primary sources
- Do not speculate on future releases, only report confirmed information

<task id="ses_02daa5960ffeKvtVmVm8nDlmEz" state="completed">
<task_result>
All sources converge. v24.11.0 blog explicitly states the LTS transition on 2025-10-28. Three independent sources agree on every data point.

---

### NODE.JS LTS VERSION (AUGUST 2026)
- **Version**: v24.x (Active LTS) — v22.x also in Maintenance LTS until 2027-04-30
- **LTS Start Date**: 2025-10-28 [VERIFIED: "This release marks the transition of Node.js 24.x into Long Term Support (LTS) with the codename 'Krypton'" — nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.11.0]
- **Codename**: Krypton
- **EOL Date**: 2028-04-30 (Active LTS until 2026-10-20, then Maintenance until EOL)
- **Latest Patch**: v24.19.0 (released 2026-08-03)

### SOURCES
1. https://github.com/nodejs/Release/blob/main/README.md — Official release schedule table: 24.x = Active LTS, codename Krypton, Active LTS Start 2025-10-28, EOL 2028-04-30. [VERIFIED: schedule.json also confirms these exact dates.]
2. https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.11.0 — Release post dated 2025-10-28 explicitly declares: "This release marks the transition of Node.js 24.x into Long Term Support (LTS) with the codename 'Krypton'. It will continue to receive updates through to the end of April 2028." [VERIFIED]
3. https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases — Confirms v24.x status = "LTS", codename = "Krypton", latest = v24.19.0 (Aug 03, 2026), and v22.x (Jod) still in LTS. [VERIFIED]
</task_result>
</task>
